basic_info.description: Refined Cow Hollow Victorian. Set on one of Cow Hollow's most coveted blocks, 2383 Greenwich is a single-family home that captures San Francisco living at its most refined. Clean architectural lines and natural finishes establish a presence that is both contemporary and timeless. Inside, light and volume define the residence. An open-plan main level flows seamlessly to a sunlit terrace. The oversized living and dining room is perfect for entertaining and is built around a fireplace with floor to ceiling built-ins and a small terrace. Chef's kitchen is a sculptural centerpiece, with oversized island, stainless appliances and wine fridge, equally suited to everyday living and elevated entertaining. Primary bedroom features an elegant fireplace, high ceilings and large closets. Lower level includes a bonus office, family room and potential additional guest space, with direct access to the landscaped terrace. Terrace, accessible from both kitchen as well as garden level, features mature plants, built-in seating area and room for lounge chairs. Moments from the boutiques and cafs of Union and Fillmore Streets, the home is a rare blend of Victorian charm and contemporary aesthetic. Walk score of 99.
